```plato

// The tolerance for a floating-point near-equality test, combining an absolute
// floor with a relative (proportional to magnitude) term: two numbers x and y
// are close when |x - y| <= Absolute + Relative * max(|x|, |y|). Both fields are
// non-negative. This is the ONE numerical-comparison epsilon record for the
// whole library (see CONVENTIONS.md - Floating-point comparison); the AlmostEqual
// overloads in algebra.library.plato accept it. Engineering Tolerance
// (uncertainty.types.plato) is a manufacturing acceptance allowance, NOT this type.
type ComparisonTolerance
    implements IValue
{
    Absolute: Number;
    Relative: Number;
}
```
